title: fix(plugin-report): a matrix report with columns draws its declared chart beside the cross-tab (objectui#10964)
body:
Fixes #10964

Clause-②: no

## What

A `matrix` report that declares `columns` now draws its declared `chart` below the cross-tab. `ReportSchema` accepts that shape, but the cross-tab branch of `DatasetReportRenderer` returned `DatasetMatrixTable` before the only `report.chart` read, so the chart parsed and drew nothing.

The non-joined presentations now share one wrapper and one chart slot. `DatasetReportChart` runs its own `chart.xAxis` × `chart.yAxis` dataset query, so it binds the same way next to a cross-tab as next to a grouped table: `xAxis` names a dataset dimension (a matrix `rows` or `columns` dimension) and `yAxis` a dataset measure. The chart still comes before a tabular or summary table (and before a matrix without `columns`, which degrades to the grouped table), and it comes after the cross-tab. The ruling on objectstack-ai/objectstack#20293 places it "beside or below the cross-tab", and below needs no new layout option.

Landing site: `packages/plugin-report/src/DatasetReportRenderer.tsx`, as the card and the claim name it.

## Premises measured on objectui `origin/main` `3ad61001b`

- Mechanism assumption 1 holds: the `presentation === 'matrix' && across.length > 0` branch returned before the `chartCfg` / `report.chart` read.
- Mechanism assumption 2 holds, so the stop valve did not fire. `DatasetReportChart` queries `[chart.xAxis]` × `[chart.yAxis]` over `report.dataset` through `useDatasetRows`, independent of the table next to it, and `scopeOrder` already narrows `report.order` to that pair. No new binding rule is involved. On the spec side, objectstack's `validate-chart-bindings` (`packages/lint`) already treats a chart on every non-`joined` report as drawn (`drawsChart` is `report.type !== 'joined'`) and binds `chart.xAxis` to a dataset dimension and `chart.yAxis` to a dataset measure: the binding this renderer now honours on the matrix arm too.
- Mechanism assumption 3 holds: no example carries a matrix report with both `columns` and a `chart`, so the pin builds its own document.

## Also changed, because this round made it false

- The out-of-spec chart-type notice said "the grouped table below carries this report's numbers". On a matrix the notice now sits after the cross-tab, so it names no position: "the report's table carries its numbers". Code comments that said the table sits "beneath" the chart slot now say "beside".
- The matrix wrapper now carries the same `flex flex-col gap-3` classes and `data-report-presentation` attribute the other non-joined presentations carry. `git grep` finds no reader of `data-report-presentation` outside the renderer.
- Docs (AGENTS.md commandment 2): the "Embedded chart" sections of `packages/plugin-report/README.md` and `content/docs/plugins/plugin-report.mdx` say where the chart draws for each type. Prose only, no fenced block.

## Tests

New pin `packages/plugin-report/src/__tests__/DatasetReportRenderer.matrixChart-10964.test.tsx`:

- a matrix report with `columns` and a `chart` draws both, with the chart after the cross-tab in document order, from its own `['status']` × `['est_hours']` query;
- the control, the same report without `chart`, draws the cross-tab only and issues exactly one query (the cross-tab's);
- an `xAxis` naming the ACROSS dimension binds the same way;
- an out-of-spec chart type on a matrix reaches the visible notice, after the cross-tab.

Reverse verification. The implementation was committed first (`cad6b4745`). The renderer file was then checked out from BASE `3ad61001b` with the pin kept, under a trap-guarded restore. After the mutation the on-disk blob equals the BASE blob `c362912eb` and the fix-marker count went from 3 to 0. The run gave `Tests 3 failed | 1 passed (4)`: the three chart cases red and the control green, as predicted in the pin's header. After the restore the on-disk blob equals the HEAD blob `9560f4d4b` and `git diff HEAD` is 0 bytes.

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-report/`: `Test Files 23 passed (23)`, `Tests 232 passed | 7 skipped (239)`. The 7 skips are the `describe.runIf(DRIVEN)` blocks of `formatValue.dateOnlyZone-10844.test.ts`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-report type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` includes the pin. The dependency closure was built first with `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/plugin-report^...'`.
- `pnpm exec eslint` on the two changed `.tsx` files: 2 files linted, 0 errors, 5 warnings. The BASE renderer carries the same 5 warnings under the same rules, shifted 3 lines by the new doc lines, so none is new.
- Exit 0: `check-changeset-presence`, `check-control-bytes`, `check-new-cross-file-line-citations`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-claims`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check-pending-changeset-literals`, `check-doc-links`, `check-doc-fence-languages`, `check-test-path-roots`, `check-unreferenced-sources`, `check-vi-mock-specifiers`.
- `check-readme-exports`: exit 1 on this checkout because 24 unrelated packages are unbuilt and it cannot judge them. With plugin-report built, its README has 0 findings.
- NOT MEASURED: `check-sdui-registration-pins`, reason: it needs a console build (`apps/console/dist/assets`), and the diff touches no registration and no `sideEffects`. Declared to CI.

ESLint narrowing, declared. (1) The population is read from eslint itself: the `.md` / `.mdx` files in this diff answer "File ignored because no matching configuration was supplied". (2) The file count is read from `--format json`: 2. (3) Invariance: `eslint.config.js` enables no type-aware linting (no `projectService`, no `parserOptions.project`), so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- objectstack `packages/spec/src/ui/report.zod.ts`: the doc comment on `ReportSchema.chart` says the chart is plotted "above the report's table". That still holds for tabular and summary reports. On a matrix with `columns` the chart now draws below the cross-tab, per the ruling. It is a doc-comment word with no accept-set change, so it is not filed. Carrier: the spec seat on objectstack-ai/objectstack#20293, when that coordination card wraps up.
- The notice and "Loading chart…" strings in `DatasetReportChart` are English literals outside the i18n catalogue. That predates this PR and is unchanged in kind. Not filed; carrier: none.
